page.content:
Local face of royal law and Robin's chief opponent.

How Sheriff of Nottingham connects

  • Artist: Robin of Sherwood — The Sheriff of Nottingham hunts Robin through the cycle.
  • Location: Nottingham — The sheriff's power is the town and shire of Nottingham.
  • Character: Guy of Gisborne — Gisborne works as the sheriff's contracted killer.
  • Character: Prince John — Later tales make Prince John the sheriff's royal cover.

What is Sheriff of Nottingham?

The Sheriff of Nottingham is less a biography than an office: he hunts the band, stages the archery contest, and embodies the corrupt shire government the ballads despise.

Key threads lead to Robin of Sherwood, Nottingham, Guy of Gisborne and Prince John.
